title.narrative: THE JERUSALEM ARAB FILM FESTIVAL (JAFF) IS A CELEBRATION OF CLASSIC AND CONTEMPORARY ARAB FILMS IN THE

description.narrative: The Jerusalem Arab Film Festival (JAFF) is a celebration of classic and contemporary Arab films in thecity of Jerusalem. The festival provides a platform to experience Jerusalem on screen; to relive andenjoy past glories, while staying abreast of innovation in the film industry. The festival is a cinematiccelebration of Jerusalem’s hidden stories and a showcase of emerging talents who will shape thefuture of Palestinian cinema. Film screenings are open to the community free of charge, ensuringunbounded access to opportunities for cinematic activities and cultural life. This young film festival isa golden opportunity for people to watch movies and film productions from the Arab World in theirhomeland. Connecting those often behind the scenes in Jerusalem; giving them opportunities tonetwork and engage in discussion with other actors, writers, and directors.
